boundaries: Git publication permanently spends this cooperating campaign opportunity, including setup failure, abort, cancellation or missing artifact.
No job initializes, repairs, refunds or resumes a trial authority; only the precreated exact SQLite bytes are used.
All locally fetched heads/tags and their full reachable history are checked; deleted/force-erased unreachable history and GitHub pull-only refs are not proven absent.
Malicious administrators and duplicate platform delivery are outside this cooperative guard; no global identity, independent antirollback or custody claim.
Whole-job interruption may prevent collection/upload; missing terminal and cleanup observations stay unknown.
No release, CURRENT/FinalUse, independent administration, Hepta integration, adoption or reward is certified.
coverage: Valid closed registration, original manifest and exact empty immutable-read SQLite authority on detached checkout
First push attempt, repository/ref/workflow/event SHA, created/deleted/forced and false-like values
Single-parent intent with one added JSON; before ancestor of source; atomic publication of unpublished source plus intent allowed
Full fetched heads/tags history rejects same-blob deletion/readdition, renamed and malformed prior markers, and reachable sibling markers
Duplicate/unknown fields, base64/size/hash drift, source closure omission/extra paths and untrusted fields rejected before imports or setup effects
Exact CPU/four-thread/ten-step strict-v1 plan and unchanged caps; numeric 4.0 does not alias integer 4
Nonempty or larger authority, wrong checkpoint, WAL/custom schema, hot registration sidecar refuse without replacement or recovery
Ignored/untracked/modified import shadows, skip-worktree/assume-unchanged, shallow/grafts/replace/alternate/partial histories and executable Git config refuse
Setup failure keeps create-only marker; second execution never reaches setup or pilot
Real bounded parent/grandchild reproduces old parent-only timeout orphan; original pilot now receives timeout=None and keeps its original phase owner
Actual nonzero child-log and exit observations retained; missing/unobserved exit or SQLite sidecar stays UNKNOWN without live recovery
Allowlisted process.log/wrapped-adapter metadata; empty logs retained; symlinks, large payloads, vanished files and malformed event preserve explicit omissions/errors
Pinned actions, read-only contents, no secret use, fixed 300-minute job bound, always collection/upload
